listings.name: Netstar Polokwane
listings.current_description: Netstar Polokwane is the local branch of the national vehicle tracking company, offering real-time GPS tracking, fleet management and vehicle recovery services for cars, motorcycles, trucks and other vehicles from its Iran Avenue office in Superbia.

listings.name: New Look Primary School
listings.current_description: New Look Primary School is a no-fee public primary school in Extension 71, Polokwane, part of the Capricorn South Schools region, teaching the CAPS curriculum to around 1,445 learners with a staff of 38 educators.

listings.name: Outdoor Warehouse
listings.address: The Farmyard Trading Post, 115 Cnr Munnik & School Rd, Bendor Ext, Polokwane, 0700
listings.current_description: Outdoor Warehouse in The Farmyard Trading Post, Bendor, is a branch of the national camping, hiking and off-road equipment retailer, stocking outdoor gear and apparel alongside in-store services such as knife sharpening and tent pole repairs.

listings.name: PostNet Flora Park
listings.address: Shop 1, Spar Shopping Centre, 293 Marshall St, Flora Park, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: PostNet Flora Park is a branch of the printing, courier and business-services franchise inside the Spar Shopping Centre on Marshall Street, offering copy and print services, domestic and international courier, stationery products and professional mailbox services.

listings.name: Protea Chemicals
listings.current_description: Protea Chemicals is a distributor and manufacturer of speciality and functional chemicals operating from Futura as part of the Omnia Group, with over 60 years' history supplying industries from food and farming to transport and textiles.

listings.name: Roman's Pizza (The Crossing)
listings.address: Shop 4, The Crossing, Cnr Grobler & Grimm Street, Fauna Park, 0699
listings.current_description: Roman's Pizza (The Crossing) is a pizza and fast-food takeaway outlet inside The Crossing Shopping Centre in Fauna Park, part of the Roman's Pizza franchise chain, serving pizza and other fast food for takeaway and delivery.

listings.name: Sizabantu Piping Systems - Limpopo Division
listings.current_description: Sizabantu Piping Systems' Limpopo Division, opened in Laboria in 2003, manufactures and distributes plastic pipe solutions for the agricultural, civil infrastructure, mining and industrial sectors, and has grown into the largest plastic pipe distributor in Limpopo.

listings.name: Sterpark Guesthouse
listings.current_description: Sterpark Guesthouse is a guesthouse on Gemini Street in Sterpark with round-the-clock reception, staff who can arrange airport transfers, air-conditioned rooms with TV, a buffet breakfast and an on-site restaurant serving South African and local cuisine.

listings.name: Tekkie Town
listings.address: Shop L18, Mall of the North, Munnik Ave, Bendor, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Tekkie Town is the Mall of the North branch of the South African branded-footwear retailer founded in 2001, part of the Pepkor group, known for bringing name-brand sports and casual shoes to towns across the country.

listings.name: The Irish House
listings.address: Corner Market Street & Thabo Mbeki Street, Polokwane Central, 0700
listings.current_description: The Irish House is a renovated National Monument in Polokwane Central, originally built in 1886 and rebuilt in 1910, that now serves as a museum with exhibitions on the cultures and origins of Limpopo's diverse peoples.

listings.name: The Pool Team Polokwane
listings.current_description: The Pool Team Polokwane is a swimming pool equipment and supplies store on General Viljoen Street, Welgelegen, stocking pool pumps, chemicals and accessories from brands such as Kreepy Krauly, Baracuda and Eartheco, plus complimentary water analysis.

listings.name: UFO Game Centre
listings.address: Shop 0018B, Game Centre, Cnr Hospital & Market St, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: UFO Game Centre is a furniture showroom inside the Game Centre mall in Polokwane, part of the United Furniture Outlets chain established in 2004, offering lounge, dining and bedroom suites along with headboards and home accessories.

listings.name: Unjani Clinic Seshego
listings.address: Mohlakaneng Shopping Centre, Polokwane Drive, Seshego
listings.current_description: Unjani Clinic Seshego is a nurse-led primary healthcare clinic at Mohlakaneng Shopping Centre, part of the Unjani social franchise network of nurse-owned clinics built from converted shipping containers, offering affordable primary care to the surrounding community.

listings.name: Virgin Active Thornhill
listings.address: Cnr Munnik Avenue and Veldspaat Str, Thornhill Shopping Centre, Polokwane, 0700
listings.current_description: Virgin Active Thornhill is the Polokwane branch of the Virgin Active health club chain, offering gym equipment, group exercise classes and fitness facilities from Thornhill Shopping Centre on the corner of Munnik Avenue and Veldspaat Street.

listings.name: Ya-Rena Construction
listings.current_description: Ya-Rena Construction is a civil engineering and structural concrete construction company established in 1995, specialising in reservoirs, bridges, dams and related infrastructure projects across Limpopo and North West province, and holds a level 3 BBBEE rating.

listings.name: Ghetto9Nine Ivy Park
listings.address: 34 Campbell Street, Ivy Park Centre, Ivy Park, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Ghetto9Nine Ivy Park is a restaurant and bakery in the Foodzone at Ivy Park Centre, serving kasi (township-style) South African cuisine alongside fresh baked goods, with orders available for delivery via Uber Eats and Mr D Food.

listings.name: Jorene's Guest House
listings.current_description: Jorene's Guest House is an owner-run seven-room guest house in Hospital Park offering en-suite rooms, most with kitchenette facilities, plus a swimming pool, dining hall, braai facilities and secure parking, a short walk from Peter Mokaba Stadium.

listings.name: Komatsu Southern Africa
listings.current_description: Komatsu Southern Africa's Polokwane branch, on Yster Street in Ladanna, supplies and services heavy earthmoving equipment -- including dozers, excavators, wheel loaders, graders, and rigid and articulated dump trucks -- for the region's mining and construction industries.

listings.name: Kuramed Pharmacy
listings.address: Shop F2, Turfloop Plaza, 697A University Road, Mankweng, 0727
listings.current_description: Kuramed Pharmacy is a retail pharmacy in Turfloop Plaza, Mankweng, trading as part of The Local Choice pharmacy network and offering dispensing, over-the-counter medicines and everyday healthcare products to the University of Limpopo community and surrounding area.

listings.name: Ledimor Guesthouse
listings.current_description: Ledimor Guesthouse is a 4-star guest house in Sterpark, next to Savannah Mall, with six luxury en-suite rooms, a swimming pool, conference facilities and a braai area, offering bed and breakfast with lunch and dinner on request.

listings.name: Lindekroon Guest House
listings.current_description: Lindekroon Guest House is a cosy seven-room bed and breakfast in Hospital Park, with garden-view en-suite rooms featuring DStv, tea and coffee facilities, a hearty included breakfast, a boardroom for up to 12 people, and secure parking.

listings.name: Masana Cafe
listings.current_description: Masana Cafe is an award-winning restaurant at Masana Hotel in Moregloed, serving traditional Limpopo cuisine through an a la carte menu and buffet, with breakfast and dinner service, weekly braai specials, and catering for groups and events.

listings.name: Old Mutual Mall of the North
listings.address: Shop L40, Mall of the North, Cnr R81 & N1 Bypass, Bendor, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Old Mutual is a pan-African financial services group, established in Cape Town in 1845 as South Africa's first mutual life insurer, offering life assurance, investment, wealth and short-term insurance products at its Mall of the North branch.

listings.name: Pecan Nut Place
listings.current_description: Pecan Nut Place is a guest house on a smallholding in Dalmada, about 5km from central Polokwane, offering en-suite rooms with air conditioning and kitchenettes, free WiFi, a garden with an outdoor pool, and free on-site parking.

listings.name: Polokwane Provincial Hospital
listings.address: Cnr Dorp Street & Hospital Street, Hospital Park, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Polokwane Provincial Hospital is a public district hospital in Hospital Park providing 24-hour emergency care with no appointment needed, alongside maternity, chronic medication, vaccination and general ward services, plus CT and MRI imaging and a neuro department.

listings.name: Royal Baeng Private Residence
listings.current_description: Royal Baeng Private Residence is a guesthouse in Dalmada set on a garden property, offering rooms with private bathrooms and air conditioning, a terrace, an on-site restaurant, free private parking, free WiFi and a 24-hour front desk.

listings.name: Sirina Thai Spa
listings.current_description: Sirina Thai Spa is a Thai massage and wellness spa on Grobler Street in Polokwane Central, offering traditional Thai massage, foot reflexology, hot stone therapy, aromatherapy body treatments and facials in 30, 60, 90 and 120-minute sessions.

listings.name: Stewarts & Lloyds Fluid Control Polokwane
listings.current_description: Stewarts & Lloyds Fluid Control Polokwane supplies steel, HDPE and PVC pipes and fittings, valves, pumps and irrigation products from its Nelson Mandela Dr branch in Superbia, part of a South African supplier network operating since 1903.

listings.name: The Crazy Store
listings.address: Shop U69, Mall of the North, Cnr R81 & N1 Bypass, Bendor, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: The Crazy Store at Mall of the North is a branch of the South African discount variety chain founded in 1995, stocking a wide mix of household, stationery, toy and gift items across its 450-plus stores nationwide.

listings.name: Tiger Wheel & Tyre Polokwane CBD
listings.address: Cnr President Paul Kruger & Grobler Street, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Tiger Wheel & Tyre Polokwane CBD is a branch of the national tyre and wheel retail chain at the corner of President Paul Kruger and Grobler Street, offering tyre sales, fitment, wheel alignment and related vehicle services.

listings.name: Tuscan Place Restaurant
listings.current_description: Tuscan Place Restaurant is an Italian-styled eatery in Penina Park with a rustic decor, garden patio and playground, serving grilled meats, salads and desserts alongside a cocktail bar, and offering live music and catering for group bookings.

listings.name: Westvaal Polokwane
listings.current_description: Westvaal Polokwane is a multi-franchise motor dealership on the corner of the R101 and Marshall Street, representing Opel, Citroen, Peugeot and Isuzu from a large complex that also houses an Isuzu Truck Centre and a used-vehicle dealership.

listings.name: Wildman Hunting & Outdoor Polokwane
listings.address: Shop 63, Thornhill Shopping Centre, Cnr Veldspaat & Munnik Avenue, Bendor, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Wildman Hunting & Outdoor Polokwane is a hunting and outdoor equipment store inside Thornhill Shopping Centre, stocking firearms, ammunition and outdoor clothing; run by a qualified gunsmith and professional hunter, it opened at Thornhill in March 2019.

listings.name: Wimpy
listings.address: Shop L12, Mall of the North, Munnik Ave, Bendor, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Wimpy at Mall of the North is a branch of the family restaurant chain that first opened in South Africa in 1967 and has been part of Famous Brands since 2007, serving burgers, breakfasts and all-day meals.

listings.name: Actus Insurance Brokers
listings.address: Proleus Building, 10 Pierre Street, Bendor Park, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Actus Insurance Brokers is an FSB-registered financial services provider in Bendor Park offering short-term insurance, retirement and estate planning for individuals, alongside corporate services such as construction and engineering guarantees, contractor's all-risk cover and group pension scheme management.

listings.name: Africa Tents Polokwane
listings.current_description: Africa Tents Polokwane manufactures and hires out event equipment including frame and stretch tents, tables and chairs, mobile chillers, freezers and kitchens, VIP toilets, jumping castles and catering equipment for weddings, corporate functions and other events around Polokwane.

listings.name: African Roots Guest House
listings.current_description: African Roots Guest House is a 22-room guest house in Hospital Park with private garden- or pool-facing entrances, antique-and-contemporary furnished rooms, two swimming pools, secure parking with backup power, and a conference venue for up to 30 delegates.

listings.name: All Car Customs
listings.current_description: All Car Customs is a vehicle customisation specialist in Annadale offering car audio and security installations (including Rockford Fosgate, Lightning Audio and MB Quart systems), plus air conditioning, bull bars, tow bars, roll bars and vehicle entertainment systems.

listings.name: Asha's Lifestyle House
listings.address: 58 Thabo Mbeki Street (R71), Fauna Park, Polokwane
listings.current_description: Asha's Lifestyle House is a restaurant in Fauna Park with a broad African cuisine menu, including dishes such as chicken curry rice, pork ribs and chicken wings, served across both indoor and outdoor seating for dine-in or takeaway.

listings.name: Big Ben Lodge
listings.current_description: Big Ben Lodge is a guesthouse in Moregloed offering air-conditioned rooms with private bathrooms, free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, set around a garden and outdoor swimming pool with an on-site restaurant and bar serving breakfast, lunch and dinner.

listings.name: Firefly Foods
listings.current_description: Firefly Foods is a butchery and deli in Ladanna selling cold meats, russians, viennas, cheese and frozen foods; since buying its own meat-processing factory in 2014, it produces its own cold meat products rather than buying them in.

listings.name: Henstock Van Der Heever Attorneys
listings.address: Jan Henstock Building, Ismini Office Park, Hillary Dr & Outspan Dr, Bendor Park, Polokwane
listings.current_description: Henstock Van Der Heever Attorneys is a law firm in Bendor Park that has served the Polokwane area since 1994, practising across areas including administration of estates, conveyancing and property law, divorce and family law, and labour law.

listings.name: H.G. Bava CC
listings.current_description: H.G. Bava CC is a family-run wholesale and retail furniture business trading in Superbia since 1910, now in its fourth generation, selling lounge suites, bedroom sets, mattresses and custom-made furniture with free delivery across Limpopo and Gauteng.

listings.name: Limpopo Cash & Carry
listings.current_description: Limpopo Cash & Carry is a wholesale FMCG and general dealer supplying groceries, cleaning products and household goods to retailers and walk-in customers across the province, with no minimum purchase required, from its Mangaan St branch in Superbia.

listings.name: Mr Price Home
listings.address: Shop L68, Mall of the North, Munnik Ave, Bendor, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Mr Price Home is the homeware and furniture chain of the Mr Price Group, with around 150 stores across South Africa offering contemporary, affordable homeware, furniture and decor. This branch trades from Mall of the North in Bendor.

listings.name: Mukurumanzi Lodge
listings.address: Plot 163, Third Avenue, Dalmada AH, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Mukurumanzi Lodge is a 4-star bush lodge in Dalmada offering eight en-suite rooms, a restaurant and sports bar, a swimming pool and jacuzzi, free WiFi and parking, plus an airport shuttle and laundry service for guests visiting Polokwane.

listings.name: Nedbank ATM Foodzone Ivy Park
listings.address: 34 Campbell Street, Ivy Park Centre, Ivy Park, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: This Nedbank ATM is a standalone self-service cash and banking point inside the Food Zone building at Ivy Park Centre, giving Ivy Park shoppers access to withdrawals and other ATM banking services without needing a full branch visit.

listings.name: Patong Guest Lodge
listings.current_description: Patong Guest Lodge is a guest lodge in Lebowakgomo offering air-conditioned twin, double and queen en-suite rooms, a swimming pool, free Wi-Fi, and conference and event facilities with a restaurant, bar and lapa for functions and garden weddings.

listings.name: Phuti Funeral Ministry Group Lebowakgomo
listings.address: House Number 3, Location Zone P, Lebowakgomo, 0737
listings.current_description: Phuti Funeral Ministry Group's Lebowakgomo branch offers funeral cover and group burial schemes, repatriation and storage of remains, cremation, and grave-related services including tombstones, exhumation and plaques, as part of a group with branches across Limpopo and beyond.

listings.name: Polokwane Chemical Supplies
listings.current_description: Polokwane Chemical Supplies (PCS Phatsima) has manufactured domestic and industrial cleaning products in Futura since 1993, growing from a small family-run operation into a full manufacturing facility, and has received the PMR.africa diamond arrow award multiple times.
